GROUND RULES: ALL EVENTS - The "30-hour replacement" and "walk-up replacement" policies will be in effect. The alternate list will be based on 2026 World Standings (as of 7 days prior to entry closing).

QUALIFICATIONS:TD - 40 entries. The top 34 from 2026 PRCA World Standings that enter will be accepted. 5 will advance from the qualifying event and 1 committee invite (must be a PRCA member). Entry fees will be $1,075 plus a $35 stock charge.
ALL CONTESTANTS - TD will occur on Saturday, October 24th. SR will occur on Sunday, October 25th.
TD - Electric eye will be used. The length of the score will be approved by the event representative.

TD STOCK DRAW - The long go-rounds and short round will be drawn prior to the beginning of the first go-round. There will be on animal for every entry plus adequate extras. The extras will be designated by the event representative or his designee. After the completion of each go-round, all extras will be run and will be used to replace any sick or injured animals. The misdraw procedure will not be used. Fresh animals will be used in the finals.

TD PAYOFF: The following amounts could decrease due to doctors released contestants who are not replaced (which would result in less entry fee money in the total payoff) or the amount could increase due to turned out contestants who are replaced (which would result in more entry fee money in the total payoff).

TD FORMAT AND PAYOFF: Two go-rounds plus a top 12 finals. $25,000 (added purse) plus $43,000 (entry fees: 40 contestants x $1,075) equals $68,000. $68,000 minus 6% ($4,080) equals $63,920 to be included in the payoff. Each of the first two go-rounds will pay 5 places: $4,610.10 (30%) for 1st, $3,841.75 (25%) for 2nd, $3,073.40 (20%) for 3rd, $2,305.05 (15%) for 4th, and $1,536.70 (10%) for 5th for a total of $15,367 paid out for each go-round. The finals will pay 4 places: $4,000 for 1st, $3,000 for 2nd, $2,000 for 3rd, and $1,000 for 4th for a total of $10,000 paid out for the finals. The average will pay 5 places: $6,955.80 (30%) for 1st, $5,796.50 (25%) for 2nd, $4,637.20 (20%) for 3rd, $3,477.90 (15%) for 4th and $2,318.60 (10%) for 5th for a total of $23,186 paid out for the average.

SR QUALIFICATIONS - 30 minimum entries. The top 24 from 2026 PRCA World Standings that enter will be accepted. 6 will advance from the qualifying event. Three go-rounds. The competition order of the third go-round will be based on times in the average after the first two go-rounds. The contestants with no qualified times in the average after the first two go-rounds will compete first in the third go-round, followed by the contestants with the slowest times in the average. The contestants with the fastest times in the average will compete last. Entry fees are $750. $80 stock charge per go-round.
SR - The qualifying event will be held in Graham, TX on October 16, 2026.
SR - Electric eye barrier may be used. The length of the score will be approved by the event representative. All rounds will be drawn prior to the first go-round.
SR PAYOFF: Pay-off will be in accordance with the rulebook for three go-rounds and an average.

TD - If a contestant who is not an active PRCA card or permit member qualifies to advance from the qualifying round to the San Angelo Cinch Roping Fiesta performance in the TD, his membership application and dues must be received by the PRCA office no later than 3 PM on Fri., Oct. 23. If his membership application is not received by the deadline, the next highest ranked contestant from the qualifying event will be accepted. (Member records 719.528.4747, Member records fax 719.548.4868).

NOTE: In order for money won at this event to count for qualify for the 2027 National Finals Rodeo or the 2027 Rookie of the Year Standings, a TD contestant must have entered and competed at a minimum of 40 PRCA Rodeos during the 2027 rodeo year and a SR contestant must have entered and competed at a minimum of 15 PRCA rodeos, during the 2027 rodeo year. Money won at this event will not count for all Around Standings, circuit standings nor will the event be applied towards a contestant's required circuit participation count. For information regarding the qualifying rounds, go to www.sanangelorodeo.com or call 325.653.7785.

GROUND RULES: ATTENTION - All contestants must purchase their 2027 membership to be accepted as an entry at the Uvalde Qualifier prior to the membership dues deadline for Uvalde. All entries will be "official" unless otherwise specified at the time of entry.

ALL CONTESTANTS - If a contestant's actions are deemed detrimental to the PRCA, the San Antonio Stock Show & Rodeo, or rodeo in general, that contestant will not be accepted as an entry at the San Antonio Stock Show & Rodeo in 2027 if he qualifies.

ALL EVENTS - There will be an extended grace period for the entries for the San Antonio Rodeo on Mon., Jan. 11, from 8:30AM to 4PM for contestants who are accepted as entries for the San Antonio Rodeo to change preferences and buddy groups at San Antonio. At this time, team ropers will also be allowed to designate or change partners.
TRADE DEADLINE - Wed., Nov. 11 at 4 PM. All confirmed trades will be final and will be processed immediately after both involved parties have confirmed through PROCOM.
ALL CONTESTANTS - Must sign a release of liability with the secretary before competing in this rodeo.

ALL CONTESTANTS WITH HORSES - In-state origin and out-of-state origin: All horses must have proof of current health papers issued within 30 days and a negative Coggins Test within the previous 12 months. Health papers for any horse must not expire while horse is on grounds.
ALL CONTESTANTS - Stalls and RV hookups will be available for rent on a first come, first serve basis. Please visit www.openstalls.com.
ALL CONTESTANTS - Must compete in all go-rounds to advance.
QUALIFICATIONS FOR THE SAN ANTONIO RODEO QUALIFIER IN UVALDE TX - No Limits. Card and Permit members will be accepted.

QUALIFICATIONS FOR THE SAN ANTONIO RODEO: BB, SB, BR, TD, SW, TR-HD, TR-HL - 50 minimum entries. No compensation. No exemptions. Up to 40 entries in each event from the finalized 2026 PRCA World Standings, and at least 10 entries in each event will advance from the Qualifying Rodeo in Uvalde to the San Antonio Rodeo. Only the top 40 in the final 2026 PRCA World Standings will be accepted as entries for San Antonio in the World Standings category. All other (except for the one committee invitee) will be accepted based on fastest times or highest scores in the average form the Qualifying Rodeo in Uvalde on November 16-21. Contestants among the top 40 in the final 2026 PRCA World Standings will not be accepted as entries at the Qualifying Rodeo in Uvalde. If less than 40 contestants from the top 40 of the finalized 2026 PRCA World Standings enter San Antonio, all remaining available positions, not to exceed 50 will be filled based on the highest scores or fastest times in the average from the Qualifying Rodeo in Uvalde. For example, if only 37 of the top 40 enter the San Antonio rodeo 13 will advance from the Uvalde Qualifier. The alternate list for replacements at San Antonio will also be based on average times and scores from the Uvalde Qualifier. For details see ground rules for San Antonio.
LOCATION - Monday, November 16, 2026 through Saturday, November 21, 2026 at the Uvalde County Fairplex located at 215 Veterans lane, Uvalde, TX.
BB,SB, BR - Mon., Nov. 16, 2026 and Tues., Nov 17, 2026.

ALL EVENTS - One go-round plus a top 20 progressive round. The top 20 in each event based on highest scores or fastest times from the first go-round will compete in the Qualifying performances on Friday, November 20 and Saturday, November 21. If there are less than 20 contestants with qualified scores or times in an event, the remaining positions in the two Qualifying performances (not to exceed 20) will be filled based on 2026 money won. If there are still less than 20 contestants with money won in 2026, remaining positions will be filled based on random draw. If ties result in more than 20 to advance to the two Qualifying performances, the tied contestant(s) with the highest ranking in the 2026 money won qualifications will advance. Placement of contestants in the progressive round will be in accordance with R2.6 of the PRCA rulebook.

ALL EVENTS - At least 10 contestants based on highest scores or fastest times in the average (after the long go-round and the progressive go-round) will be eligible to be accepted as entries for the San Antonio Rodeo. These contestants or teams must notify PROCOM to confirm their intent to compete at the San Antonio Rodeo. Failure to notify PROCOM may result in the next highest ranked contestant being contacted and offered the position. If a contestant chooses not to be accepted as an entry at the San Antonio Rodeo due to injury or any other reason, the next highest ranked contestant from the Qualifying performances will be contacted and offered the position. This procedure will be followed until all available positions are filled. These contestants (or teams) will be randomly placed among the other contestants (or teams) that have already been accepted for the San Antonio Rodeo. If ties in the average result in more contestants (or teams) to advance to the San Antonio rodeo than there are positions available, the tied contestant(s) with the single highest score or fastest time at the qualifying rodeo will advance. If still tied, the contestant(s) with the highest ranking in the 2026 PRCA World Standings will advance.
RE - Riding stock for the Qualifying performance will be drawn at least 24 hours prior to the performance.

RE - Three re-rides will be available (and on site) for each performance for each of the riding events. In addition, three more re-rides will be designated to be used, "only if needed", in the case that one or more of the three originally designated re-rides are used to replace a sick or injured animal that was drawn by a contestant. If in the event that more re-rides are awarded that there are re-ride animals available, additional re-rides will be drawn from animals in that pen.

RE- If an animal has already been drawn for a contestant who turned out, the replacement contestant will draw an animal from a pool consisting of all animals that have been notified as turned out through PROCOM (includes D.R's and V.I.R's) and the 1st available designated re-ride.
BR - Day money will be paid for each day of slack.
TD - There will be a disqualification for a jerk down as long as all criteria are in compliance with the jerk down policy

TD: Thursday, November 19 at 9 AM. One go-round. Top 20 in the long go advance to the qualifying rodeo performances on Friday, November 20 and Saturday, November 21. Payoff will be accordance to the rulebook. Stock charge $30 per contestant.

SW: Thursday, November 19 at 12 PM. One go-round. Top 20 in the long go advance to qualifying rodeo performances on Friday, November 20 and Saturday, November 21. Payoff will be in accordance with the rulebook. Stock charge $30 per contestant.

TR: Tuesday, November 17 at 3 PM. One go-round. Top 20 in the long go will advance to the qualifying rodeo performances on Friday, November 20 and Saturday, November 21. Contestants must rope with the same partner for both go-rounds. Payoff will be accordance with the rulebook. Stock charge $15 per contestant.

TE - If a tie results in more than 20 to advance to the performances on Friday, November 20 and Saturday, November 21 the contestant with the highest ranking based on 2026 World standings will advance. In the TR, the team with the single partner with the highest ranking based on 2026 World standings will advance.
TE - If a timed event animal escapes (or a re-run is due for any other reason), the extra will be used. Only escaped animals go back into the herd.

ALL EVENTS - The San Antonio Stock Show & Rodeo Qualifier and the San Antonio Stock Show & Rodeo will each count as separate rodeos. All entries are official unless contestant specifies otherwise at time of entry.
PAYOFF: $5,000 added purse plus entry fees. Pay-off will be in accordance with the rulebook for one go-round plus a progressive round.
ALL EVENTS - Money will be divided equally in case of splits and any odd pennies will be dropped.
